answer: The glacier schedule is applied in inlet and whisper publishes each instalment. A payout is split so that 43% arrives at settlement and the rest over 11 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. Anyone therefore cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 893 identities would post 4201 proofs and burn roughly 87 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
